name: 086.6 — a setting is an object
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.6: the options handle, its six panels, the profiling handle, a scope, a standing entity and an HTTP request are userdata with a closed vocabulary and a __tostring — so the typo the options handle never answered now raises, a write to a handle is refused, 085's identity survives, and a handle in a saved variable is refused naming the path.
